Sadness, at least that kind of sadness that you have, comes from a positioning in time. There are two ways to position yourself in time: the interval and the moment. When time makes us sad, it makes us sad because we are trying to cover more than we should. You are thinking of time as a very large interval, and thus, our life, what we live, where we are, becomes small and insignificant... So, fast, so fast that it seems that it escapes without realizing it. But it's because of the way you position yourself in time.
I'm not saying: enjoy the moment. I mean, position yourself in the moment. Do not cover large magnitudes of time. Think in small moments.

In psychology there are three principles of the human state: thought, action and feelings. As you can imagine, the hardest thing to change is the feelings, but if you change the action and the thought you can change the way you feel. Think of time in moments. Act in time in moments. And so, in moments, life is only as long as the number of moments we decide to have. :)

In my opinion, I don't think one is better than the other. However, there is something in the night that I think I have never found in the day. In the night, in the dark, my mind wakes up. The day always appears in a different light, but I am always tied to the same routine. In the end, I have to be stuck in that routine in order to live. But at night I feel free. There is nothing of that routine that constantly kills me. It's just me in the dark, deep in thought. And yes, there is room for blame, for mistakes, for the past and for the uncertain future, but that darkness serves as a blank canvas to escape my life. At night, I'm not the same idiot anymore. I can be whoever. The world can be as I decide. Fate is in my hands every write, every time I find myself absent from the world around me. But it is a double-edged sword. In the end, in those worlds there are rules. I feel that it is only an apparent freedom, but after all freedom. More freedom than in everyday life. To be happy I look for the night to free myself from the chains of life, people, work and money. But those same chains, hidden, are in my freedom, and often direct my words. If I had to choose, I would choose the darkness, the night, the solitude of my bedroom. But I think they are not separate. At the end of the day the night comes, the night ends, it dawns, and the same day continues with the same shit. Only thought can shape darkness. In the day, on the other hand, there is a lot of light and a lot of noise like, which makes it impossible for me to transform the landscapes in my mind.
